assets.label: 오르벨 에어 · 퍼스트 클래스
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: final 2:5 portrait scene-card background for the fictional airline FIRST CLASS relaxation experience in a Korean rest app.
The attached image is a draft with conventional economy-style seating. KEEP its immersive seated first-person perspective, two oval windows with tranquil evening sky and clouds, beautiful warm cabin lighting, realistic photography and 2:5 portrait format. Upgrade the visible cabin into an unmistakably refined FIRST CLASS LIE-FLAT SUITE. Replace the upright economy seatback with its tray and seat pocket entirely; no rows of economy seats.
Brand context from the actual project: ORVEL AIR is a FICTIONAL airline with deep navy identity #1C2E4A and a restful first-class lie-flat-seat service. The name is context only: absolutely NO brand name, writing, logo or monogram should be inside this image. Convey identity through tailored navy upholstery, warm ivory bedding, champagne-colored trim and coherent cabin materials.
Camera and scene: viewer reclining comfortably in their own spacious private first-class aircraft suite, eye level low, looking gently toward the sidewall and two realistically sized oval airplane windows. Broad soft upholstered armrest, a restrained navy leather seat-shell edge and a simple elegant side console at close reach; the viewer's lie-flat berth with fluffy ivory bedding and a navy-trimmed blanket enters the lower foreground. No visible body parts. The generous private suite partition is low enough to leave the oval windows and real curved aircraft ceiling visible. Truly a commercial airliner's premium first-class interior, not a hotel or private jet room. Believable scale and aircraft architecture.
Lighting: warm dim champagne ambient lighting, soft subtle cool-blue light at the window; an extremely restrained hint of muted mauve overhead lighting is optional, no neon. Quiet evening cruising, sheltered and luxurious but intimate, natural textile/leather/ivory-matte surfaces, no glitter or ornate decoration. No bright TV screens, no food, wine glasses, trays, flowers or luxury prop clutter.
Composition: single standalone full-bleed very tall portrait 2:5, ideally 1024x2560. Window/suite relationship central at 25-65% height; quieter upper ceiling and lower soft bedding for app copy added separately. Physically convincing premium travel photography, soft light, detailed fabrics, natural depth, no CGI.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, labels, signage, interface, borders, collage, people, body parts or airline emblems. No economy row seats, seatback tray tables or seat pockets. Deliver one finished photographic background.

assets.label: 호텔 메이플린 · 스위트 턴다운
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: final 2:5 portrait scene-card background for a fictional hotel's cozy SUITE TURNDOWN relaxation experience.
The attached image is the draft. Preserve its beautiful immersive first-person reclining-in-bed viewpoint, plush ivory duvet close in foreground, oatmeal curtains, warm bedside lamp and gentle Korean evening skyline. Refine it into a softly luxurious, deeply comfortable suite after turndown service. Only one bedroom scene, not a wide hotel lobby or brochure montage.
Brand context verified in project: HOTEL MAPLINE is a FICTIONAL hotel whose identity is rich warm brown #3B2A1E, with warm champagne light, ivory bedding and quiet rain ambience. Name is context only: absolutely NO hotel name, text, logos, monogram or brand marks inside the image. Express identity only in consistent warm walnut/oak detail, matte brown accents, creamy textiles and thoughtful lamplight.
Primary request: settled into a perfectly soft turned-down bed in a welcoming Korean hotel suite at blue hour. Plump white cotton duvet naturally folded back near the foreground, subtle beige knitted throw and a small glimpse of pillow edge, low comfortable eye level, no body parts visible. A simple warm fabric-shade bedside lamp and oak/walnut nightstand at one side; refined soft upholstered wall panel, comfortable quiet lounge chair beyond and tall linen curtains framing a window. A few delicate natural rain beads and trails on the outside of the large window catch the blue hour light, with soft distant warm city-light bokeh and a low Korean hillside beyond. The rain should feel calming and private, not stormy. Plenty of breathable room around the chair gives a suite feel without turning grand or cold. No excessive objects.
Lighting and style: extraordinarily inviting amber lamp pools, rich brown wood, warm cream textile texture contrasted with subtle soft-blue rainy dusk, natural real photographic exposure. Soft cozy shadows and tactile bedding, no harsh contrast or overly orange wash. Actual comfortable boutique luxury, not ornate palace decor. Must feel like I am resting in the bed, not photographing it from across the room.
Composition: one full-bleed very tall 2:5 portrait photo, ideally 1024x2560, central window/lounge/lamplight at 25-65% height, quiet upper curtain/wall and lower duvet for app copy rendered later. No wide-angle distortion, natural lens perspective, premium photorealism and no CGI.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, hotel name, logo, stationery, bed printing, signs, watermark, interface, collage, border, people, body parts or visible TV content. No flowers, food, wine, trays, bath or unnecessary props. Deliver one finished background.
